headline: Congress named a Houston post office building after Vanessa Guillen, a soldier whose case drew national attention.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 5302 Galveston Road in Houston, Texas, as the "Vanessa Guillen Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, mail delivery, staffing, or any rules that apply to people.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 5, 2023.
